item.title: Texas softball schedule at DeMarini Invitational altered with unexpected road trip
item.description: Texas takes on No. 16 Arizona and No. 10 Stanford on Friday at Stanford Softball Stadium (2 p.m. and 4:30 p.m.) as planned, and after playing Boise State on Saturday at 2 p.m., the Longhorns will take a short trip to Santa Clara University to take on the Broncos at 6:30 p.m. That game is closed to the public, officials said. The game against the Cardinal will be streamed on ACC Network Extra.

item.title: No. 4 Texas cans season-high in 3-pointers, blows out Arkansas in Fayetteville
item.description: The Longhorns entered the game No. 346 out of 359 Division I programs, making 3.8 3-pointers per game. They're even lower in attempts per game at No. 357 with 12.3, but they found something they liked against the lowly Razorbacks, who dropped to 0-13 in Southeastern Conference play.

item.title: 'My ballot was not private.' Hutto voting site privacy concerns amid city–county rift
item.description: The Hutto Discovery United Methodist Church serves as the city’s only early voting location this election cycle.

item.title: United States wins 3rd Olympic gold in women's hockey, beating Canada 2-1 on Megan Keller's OT goal
item.description: MILAN (AP) — A last Olympic goal for Hilary Knight, a gold medal-winning overtime one for Megan Keller, and the Americans cemented their reputation as one of the most dominant women’s hockey teams to take the ice. item.title: Rainbows, paintings removed from some Austin crosswalks after state, federal orders
item.description: Three crosswalks in Austin neighborhoods were redone this week as part of federal and state government requirements to remove "political ideologies" from streets.

item.title: Cloudier and cooler Friday ahead of Saturday cold front
item.description: The persistent clouds will keep temperatures much lower on Friday with 70s possible where the sun breaks through, but afternoon temperatures only in the 60s elsewhere. -- Nick Bannin

item.title: New enforcement role at Texas Education Agency looks into educator misconduct
item.description: Making sure the more than 5.5 million students in public schools across Texas have a safe learning environment will now fall on Levi Fuller.

item.title: After teen's death in Florida, attorneys seek to stop Austin thrill ride
item.description: A KXAN investigation found a foreign ride maker — found negligent in the 2022 death of a teen in Florida — is producing a new drop tower ride at COTALAND in Austin. COTALAND said its drop tower will be significantly different and safer. The teen's family is trying to block its ride from being built, arguing the manufacturer shouldn't be allowed to do business in the U.S. after failing to pay a court judgment in the teen's death.

item.title: Questions abound after University of Texas regents vote to limit 'controversial topics' from courses
item.description: The University of Texas Board of Regents voted Thursday to approve a proposed policy that would change the UT system's rules for faculty around teaching "controversial topics."

item.title: 'You are innocent': Judge signs orders formally clearing former suspects in Austin yogurt shop murders
item.description: After spending decades of their lives wrongly accused of one of Austin's most infamous crimes, four men previously believed to have killed four teenage girls at the I Can’t Believe It’s Yogurt! shop on Anderson Lane in 1991 will finally see their names cleared.
